name: RCECAP
recent: RCE Capital 公布 2026 财年第二季度业绩，净利按年增长近 10%，主要来自更高的再融资活动。公司宣布每股 3 仙的第一次中期股息，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 7 日。此外，公司于 10 月终止 2020 年员工认股计划，并实施新的员工认股计划。
notable: 公布 2026 财年第二季度业绩，净利按年增长近 10%。
宣布第一次中期股息每股 3 仙。
终止 2020 年员工认股计划并实施新的员工认股计划。
risks: 2020 年员工认股计划下未行使的 30,271,000 份期权已失效并注销。
多名主要股东（包括 Amcorp Group、Tan Sri Azman Hashim 等）在 10 月多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026 财年第二季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 78,386,000 令吉，按年下降 1.8%，按季下降 1.4%；净利为 30,426,000 令吉，按年增长 17.1%，按季下降 12.2%；净利率为 38.8%，低于上一季度的 43.6%。

recent_en: RCE Capital reported its 2Q FY2026 results, with net profit rising nearly 10% year-on-year on higher refinancing activity. The company declared a first interim dividend of 3 sen per share, with ex-date on 7 Dec 2026. It also terminated the 2020 ESS and implemented a new ESS in October.
notable_en: Announced 2Q FY2026 results with net profit up nearly 10% year-on-year.
Declared a first interim dividend of 3 sen per share.
Terminated the 2020 ESS and implemented a new ESS.
risks_en: 30,271,000 unexercised options under the 2020 ESS lapsed and were cancelled.
Several substantial shareholders (including Amcorp Group and Tan Sri Azman Hashim) filed multiple changes in shareholding in October.
earnings_en: For 2Q FY2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was MYR 78,386,000, down 1.8% year-on-year and 1.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 30,426,000, up 17.1% year-on-year but down 12.2% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 38.8%, lower than 43.6% in the previous quarter.
